cover.title: College Sticker Price vs Net Tuition
cover.label: $45K

lines.text: Private colleges averaged $45,000 tuition. The average freshman paid far less.
lines.say: Private colleges averaged forty-five thousand dollars. The average freshman paid far less.

lines.text: In 2025-26, aid cut that to $16,910 for first-year students.
lines.say: In twenty twenty-five to twenty-six, aid cut that to sixteen thousand nine hundred ten for first-year students.

lines.text: That's $45,000 minus $28,090 in aid, about 38% of sticker.
lines.say: That's forty-five thousand minus twenty-eight thousand ninety in aid, about thirty-eight percent of sticker.

lines.text: The dorm is a business too: housing and food at public four-years averaged $13,900 that year.
lines.say: The dorm is a business too: housing and food at public four-years averaged thirteen thousand nine hundred dollars that year.

lines.text: Donor gifts go into endowments, which returned 10.9% on average in fiscal 2025.
lines.say: Donor gifts go into endowments, which returned ten point nine percent on average in fiscal twenty twenty-five.

lines.text: Spending an average 4.9% of the median $253.6 million endowment funds about $12.4 million.
lines.say: Spending an average four point nine percent of the median two hundred fifty-three point six million endowment funds about twelve point four million.

lines.text: From 2026 tax years, schools with the most endowment per student face a tax of up to 8%, up from a flat 1.4%.
lines.say: From twenty twenty-six tax years, schools with the most endowment per student face a tax of up to eight percent, up from a flat one point four percent.

lines.text: That's the money. Follow for more.
lines.say: That's the money. Follow for more.

post.title: 2025-26: $45,000 college sticker, $16,910 avg net tuition
post.ig:
Private colleges averaged $45,000 tuition in 2025-26. The average freshman paid far less.
College Board, 2025-26: private nonprofit sticker $45,000 vs an estimated $16,910 net for first-year students (about 38%).
Housing and food average $13,900 at public four-years and $15,920 at private nonprofits (2025-26).
Endowments returned 10.9% on average in FY2025 and spent about 4.9%; the median endowment is $253.6 million (NACUBO-Commonfund).
The 2025 tax law sets a tiered endowment tax of up to 8% for tax years starting in 2026.
Sources: College Board Trends in College Pricing and Student Aid 2025, 2025 NACUBO-Commonfund Study of Endowments.
News and education, not financial advice.

post.yt_desc:
Average private nonprofit tuition was $45,000 in 2025-26, but first-year students paid an estimated $16,910 in net tuition after grants and tax benefits (College Board). Endowments returned 10.9% on average in FY2025 with a 4.9% spending rate (NACUBO-Commonfund), and the 2025 tax law adds a tiered endowment tax of up to 8% from 2026 tax years. News and education, not financial advice.
